cuid_explanation: Driver.cpp:161-200 defaults to hash mode; hashes input filename then every non-input argument, including output path and -###. Clang.cpp:8503-8505 forwards this ID to cc1. Fresh output path changes the symbol; the separate -### trace also hashes differently from actual compilation. ASTContext.cpp:15533-15539 hashes the driver CUID again using MD5-low64; CodeGenModule.cpp:1333-1341 emits that hash as the __hip_cuid suffix.

symbol_suffix_attempt.explanation: The object suffix is already MD5-low64 of the driver CUID. Passing the suffix as -cuid hashes it a second time.
